details: A 2-block shattered tree is an ordinary shattered Littlestone tree.
proof: The 2-block condition only restricts the coordinate labels allowed in an ordinarily shattered Littlestone tree. Therefore every tree counted by $\mathrm{B}_2(\mathcal H)$ is counted by $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)$, and $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{B}_2(\mathcal H)$.
name: Littlestone Dimension / 2-Block Littlestone Dimension
